smells.finding: The replan verifier validates nested G1 values by cloning and rewriting an entire manifest through verify_manifest_shape. This reaches through the G1 seam and loses the caller's real graph context: issue replacements are validated alone, so a dependency on B is refused even when B exists in the result wave. Expose/use a context-aware G1 component validator or validate the assembled result plan through the public seam.
